Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) and lateral view (Figure 1b) show an ill-defined, broad-based opacity in the right mid-lung zone abutting the mediastinum. The presence of air-bronchograms within this consolidation is a hallmark sign of pneumonia (round pneumonia), distinguishing it from a solid malignant mass which typically displaces or obstructs airways rather than containing patent air-filled bronchi.
